name: Banned Superlatives & Guarantees
summary: Never use guaranteed returns, guaranteed, risk-free, or free money in financial marketing.
description: Regulatory guidelines prohibit absolute guarantees on variable-yield financial products or misleading depositors about risk.
passExample: Competitive rates designed for your financial growth.
failExample: Lumen Saver: guaranteed 8% returns, risk-free and free money!

name: Preferred Terminology: Savings Accounts
summary: Use 'Lumen Savings' instead of legacy terms like 'Lumen Saver'.
description: Brand nomenclature update per Q1 2026 rebrand guidelines.
passExample: Open your Lumen Savings account today.

name: Customer vs Account Holder
description: Lumen Bank institutional voice guidelines specify 'account holder' to reflect relationship depth.
passExample: Every account holder receives priority support.

name: Rewards vs Cashback
description: Regulatory term for credit/debit card reward points program.
passExample: Earn 5% festive rewards on debit card spends.
failExample: Get instant cashback on your purchases.

name: Savings Interest Rate Accuracy
summary: Savings rate must match active Claim Ledger entry F1 (6.5% p.a.).
description: All published interest rates must reference current ALCO approved schedules.
passExample: Earn up to 6.5% p.a. on your savings balance.
failExample: Earn 8% p.a. on your savings balance.
